presets.label: Mesh gradient
presets.hint: Four soft colours drifting into each other; the first one leans towards your pointer.

presets.label: Silk gradient
presets.hint: A tilted, slowly folding ribbon of colour in the style of modern product pages. Scrolling shifts the palette; the pointer nudges the folds.

presets.label: Noise flow
presets.hint: Contour lines streaming through warped noise, like wind on a weather map. The flow bends towards your pointer.

presets.label: Metaballs
presets.hint: Glossy blobs that melt into each other like a lava lamp; one of them follows your pointer.

presets.label: Grain & dither
presets.hint: A soft dusk gradient broken into retro dither steps with film grain on top; a pool of light follows your pointer.

presets.label: Ember ribbon
presets.hint: A warm ribbon of orange, sand and lilac folding slowly across the frame, with a fine print grain.
presets.attribution: Adapted from ShaderGradient presets (github.com/ruucm/shadergradient), MIT © ruucm, stone-skipper

presets.label: Violet orb
presets.hint: Seen up close, a sphere of periwinkle and violet that twists into soft spirals.
presets.attribution: Adapted from ShaderGradient presets (github.com/ruucm/shadergradient), MIT © ruucm, stone-skipper

presets.label: Mint tide
presets.hint: Rolling swells of mint and aqua fading to white, like light under shallow water. No grain.
presets.attribution: Adapted from ShaderGradient presets (github.com/ruucm/shadergradient), MIT © ruucm, stone-skipper

presets.label: Glass orbit
presets.hint: A glossy teal and amber sphere seen from below, catching soft reflections from a studio around it.
presets.attribution: Adapted from ShaderGradient presets (github.com/ruucm/shadergradient), MIT © ruucm, stone-skipper

presets.label: Night swell
presets.hint: Slate and lavender waves rising out of near black: a calm, dark backdrop.
presets.attribution: Adapted from ShaderGradient presets (github.com/ruucm/shadergradient), MIT © ruucm, stone-skipper

presets.label: Indigo bloom
presets.hint: White and gold blooming out of deep indigo on a slowly turning sphere. No grain.
presets.attribution: Adapted from ShaderGradient presets (github.com/ruucm/shadergradient), MIT © ruucm, stone-skipper

presets.label: Deep space
presets.hint: Electric violet and coral drifting through black, like a nebula. No grain.
presets.attribution: Adapted from ShaderGradient presets (github.com/ruucm/shadergradient), MIT © ruucm, stone-skipper

presets.label: Tangerine sea
presets.hint: A sea of hot orange with rust-red troughs, seen low across its surface. No grain.
presets.attribution: Adapted from ShaderGradient presets (github.com/ruucm/shadergradient), MIT © ruucm, stone-skipper
